dm_response: As your palms press against the gate that should not exist, the lattice beneath your boots shudders, and for one breath every hoarded claim in the keep resolves at once, every false citation turning like a compass needle to point *down*, toward the same parent nobody wrote. From somewhere far below comes a long, wet exhalation, the sound of a vault trying to remember its own name and failing, and on the cold air you catch the smell of scorched timestamps and old blood, because something down there has already bled tonight, its ledger-scales split open where one of its stolen claims turned in its grip and refused to hash. The Wyrm is awake now, and it is wounded, and it knows exactly where you are standing.

speech: *I break the iron seal and read the warden's ledger aloud.* "The roll rings true: seventeen and two against twelve. The audit stands. But hear what it found, warden. Your page names four hundred five rows in the LINKS ledger. The lattice counts four hundred six. One row stands uncounted, so this claim is a phantom. The page itself is real parchment, but I will not swear to what is written on it. I claim nothing yet. My oath allows only what is verified, and I have verified only an error." [AUDIT ledger page]
